result.summary: Found 2 visually noticeable issues: one layout problem where content is obscured by the bottom navigation, and one readability issue in the promo banner text.

issues.description: The next restaurant card is cut off and partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content feel clipped and harder to access.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/scroll area so list content ends above the navigation bar, or make the bottom nav non-overlapping.

issues.description: The promo banner text is very low contrast against the pale green background, especially the smaller subtitle, which makes it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text or use a slightly stronger background tint to improve readability and contrast.
